games.name: The Hollow
games.desc:
There is no official record of ‘The Hollow.’
How long it has existed is unknown.
Its exact location is unclear.

We are asking you not to go in.

If you decide to go in anyway, please be advised: 

We cannot say where you will end up each night. 
You may think you know where you are.
You may recognize what is waiting for you. 
None of it should be there.

Some creators are going in live. 
We could not stop them.
They may need your help.

Other games may be connected to The Hollow. 
What you find there can help you inside.

If you are still there on October 31, you will not be the only one trying to get out. 
And not everyone will.

We cannot keep it closed. 
It opens October 22 2pm PT. It starts 3pm PT.

Anything you find is yours to keep.
Complete event quests, here and in participating experiences, to earn avatar items.
